## Context
Residual non-code capacity-measurement work split from `witted-invisible-roan` after the serving-path fix landed.

Parent residual AC: the measurement campaign has produced the numbers the OOM decision needs — peak MCP RSS during a gate, steady-state RSS per container, and how RSS scales with ticket size.

Current operator ruling: run the measurement now if it does not require pausing parallel sessions. If it would require pausing them, defer and report. This ticket is an operational evidence campaign, not a code change.

## Plan
1. Confirm whether the measurement can be done non-disruptively from existing host/CloudWatch data plus read-only live probes. Do not pause or stop parallel sessions.
2. Collect steady-state per-container RSS from the live host (`docker stats --no-stream` or equivalent read-only command) and/or CloudWatch `rebar/host:container_memory_rss_bytes` over the current window.
3. Collect peak MCP/gate RSS from existing `GATE_PEAK_RSS` markers and CloudWatch/container metrics for recent gate windows; do not start artificial load if doing so would compete with active sessions.
4. Estimate RSS-vs-ticket-size/capacity from the recorded gate samples and ticket-store sizing data already captured in the parent/children. If the existing data is enough after the host resize and memory caps, record the conclusion; otherwise record the exact missing measurement and why it requires a quiescent window.
5. Post commands, timestamps, source windows, values, and caveats as ticket comments. Link any resulting implementation/design follow-up tickets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A comment records peak MCP/gate RSS, steady-state per-container RSS, and RSS-vs-ticket-size/capacity figures sufficient to choose a memory limit, instance size, or concurrency limit from data rather than guesswork.
- [ ] A comment records the measurement method, time window, source commands/log queries, and caveats.
- [ ] The ticket either closes after a completed non-disruptive campaign or records that the campaign is deferred because the remaining measurement would require pausing parallel sessions.
- [ ] Any resulting implementation/design follow-up tickets are linked from this ticket.

## Verification
- Read-only host/CloudWatch/log commands are included in the evidence comment.
- No code files are modified for this ticket.
